title: Circuit Deconstuction
statement: Let $C$ be a finite acyclic circuit with $n>0$ input vertices and a valid designated output. Form a circuit with the same number of inputs by prepending the three-gate constant prefix, then applying the strict gate transformation with parameter $n$ to each gate of $C$ in order, and taking the prefix-shifted index of $C$’s output as the new output.
hypotheses_covered: The number of input vertices satisfies $0<n$.
